label: Stemma and copy-text
text: AR.O.A1.3.4 Stemma and copy-text. Lachmann's stemma assumes descent by copying with shared errors. Greg's copy-text rationale (1950) chooses the text for accidentals. Each yields a claim about the authorial reading.

warrant.standard: Instrumental and documentary evidence converge on the making
warrant.defeaters: Sample or document not from the work
